Class AlgorithmMovementRange

java.lang.Object
utils.AlgorithmMovementRange
public class AlgorithmMovementRange extends Object
Utility class that calculates the movement and attack direction of NonPlayable enemies with ranged attack capabilities relative to the player.

This class provides a static method to determine the optimal action for an enemy: either move towards the player, attack in a direction, or remain idle if blocked. It considers distance, enemy attack speed, and collisions.

  • Method Details

    • algorithmMovementRange

      public static String algorithmMovementRange(GamePanel gamePanel, NonPlayable enemy, Playable player)
      Determines the movement or attack direction for a NonPlayable enemy with range attacks.

      The algorithm calculates the horizontal and vertical differences between the enemy and the player. It then chooses the primary direction to move or attack based on:

      • If the enemy is in a damage state (`cpdmg != 0`), it returns the damage direction.
      • If the enemy's attack speed is low (`invalid input: '<' 10`), it performs an immediate attack in the dominant direction ("atk-left", "atk-right", "atk-up", "atk-downds").
      • If the distance to the player is less than 200 units, the enemy moves towards the player, checking for collisions before deciding the final movement direction ("up", "down", "left", "right").
      Possible return values:
      • "atk-left", "atk-right", "atk-up", "atk-downds" – ranged attack in a direction
      • "left", "right", "up", "down" – movement direction towards the player
      • "none" – no valid movement or attack possible
      • enemy's damage direction – if enemy.getCpdmg() != 0
      Parameters:
      gamePanel - the main game panel containing all entities and tiles
      enemy - the NonPlayable enemy whose action is being calculated
      player - the Playable player character that the enemy targets
      Returns:
      a String representing the movement or attack direction
